title: phyllanthus lacteus
intro: Phyllanthus lacteus, commonly known as the Bhumyamalaki, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. The Bhumyamalaki plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including liver and kidney disorders, due to its health benefits of promoting liver function, detoxifying the body, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of the Bhumyamalaki plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, which help to protect the liver and kidneys from damage. The bioactive constituents of the Bhumyamalaki plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
